usedFor: Roma holds your lists and tasks, and Zoom registers an attendee through “Register Attendee for Webinar” after “New Item”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Item” in Roma, then “Register Attendee for Webinar” in Zoom
bestTemplate.why: A new row on a list is a person to register, so it feeds the webinar without retyping.

watchOut: “New Item” fires for tasks, notes and rows alike, so limit it to the list that holds attendees.
